evidence_quotes: This year’s artists Alexander Rybak, Rune Larsen, Maria Haukaas Mittet, Hans Marius Hoff Mittet and Ingrid Berg Mehus are the star team that will create a magical Christmas atmosphere in churches all over southern Norway in November and December!
data.reason: The item announces Alexander Rybak's participation as an artist in the upcoming 'Stille Natt, Hellige Natt' Christmas concert tour across Norway.
